definitions.ask: Which color should a Work badge show when its count exactly meets the limit?
definitions.why: Magenta fills the widest unused hue gap and stays clear of red, the accent, and blue

choices.label: Plum in light mode, orchid in dark; no Bob chip uses it, and it clears every Work tone
Simplest CSS, but in light mode it sits next to red (ΔE 3 at the 14% chip tint)
Reads as "complete", but matches the PROJECTS/BLOCKED accent and looks blue if colorblind
